title: Qualify and advertise rope pair modes
requires: Each driver that will advertise rope-capsule contact or attachment
scope: Run public-API capsule, attachment, conservation, capacity and lifecycle gates before exposing new rope records.
acceptance: Self/pair crossing, friction, winding, stretch, endpoint ownership, attachment break and long-run cases pass per advertising driver.
Capability evidence separates capsule self contact, pair contact and endpoint attachment and states their limits.
